catalyst.craft: Let the antagonist start the second act. A villain who arrives on his own terms is harder to beat and cheaper to write.
catalyst.craftTanglish: Rendaam angatha edhiriye aarambikkattum. Thanoda nibandhanaila varra villain-a vella kashtam, ezhudha milivu.

debate.inFilm: Barely exists. The hero does not weigh whether to listen - he begins the interrogation. The absence of deliberation is a characterisation, and the film will spend two hours making him pay for it.
debate.inFilmTanglish: Kittathatta illave illa. Kekkalaamaa vendaamaa-nu hero yosikkala - neraa vichaaranai aarambikraan. Yosikkaadhadhu oru characterisation; adhukku vilai kattura maadhiri rendu mani neram padam aakkudhu.
debate.craft: A hero who never debates is a hero the third act can humble. Skipping the beat is only a hole if nothing later collects on it.
debate.craftTanglish: Oru naalum yosikkaadha hero-va moonaam angam adakkalaam. Andha kattatha vittadhu, apparam adhukku yaarum kanakku kekkala-nna mattum thaan oru kuzhi.

break-into-two.inFilm: He accepts the terms of the game and agrees to hear the first story. The active choice is to listen - which in this film is the most dangerous thing he can do.
break-into-two.inFilmTanglish: Andha vilaiyaattoda nibandhanaiya ethukittu, mudhal kadhaiya kekka oppukraan. Seyal thervu-nu paatha 'kekkuradhu' - indha padathula avan seiyakoodiya romba aabathhaana velai adhu thaan.
break-into-two.craft: The riskiest active choice is sometimes agreeing to receive information. Make listening a decision and it becomes drama.
break-into-two.craftTanglish: Romba aabathhaana seyal thervu sila samayam 'thagaval-a ethukkuradhu' thaan. Kekkuradha oru mudivaa aakkunga - adhu naadagamaa maarum.

b-story.inFilm: The defence lawyer at home. She holds the opposing position inside the hero's marriage, so the thematic argument does not need a scene to be scheduled - it is already at his dinner table.
b-story.inFilmTanglish: Veetla irukkura defence lawyer. Hero-oda kalyaana vaazhkkaikkulleye edhir nilaipaadu irukku - so theme vaadhathukku thaniya oru katchi podavendiya avasiyame illa; adhu yaarkanave avanoda saapaadu mesaila irukku.
b-story.craft: Put the counter-argument inside the household. A theme you have to schedule a scene for is a theme the film is not really about.
b-story.craftTanglish: Edhir vaadhatha veettukkulleye vachudunga. Oru theme-ukku thaniya katchi podanum-nna, andha theme pathi padam unmaiyila illa.

fun-and-games.inFilm: The three stories, nested. This is the promise of the premise and the formal invention at once - each tale is a complete moral riddle, and each one also reframes a fact from the hero's own case. The film is entertaining and dismantling him in the same beat.
fun-and-games.inFilmTanglish: Moonu kadhaigal, ullukkulla adukkapattu. Idhu thaan kadhaikkaruvin vaakkuruthiyum, adhe samayam amaippu kandupidippum - ovvoru kadhaiyum oru muzhusaana arasiyal-thanmai pudhir; adhodu hero-oda sontha vazhakkula irukkura oru unmaiyaiyum thirumba vaikkudhu. Ore kattathula padam avana kalikkavum vekkudhu, pirikkavum seiyudhu.
fun-and-games.craft: The best Fun and Games entertains and erodes at the same time. If your second act is only fun, the midpoint has to do all the work alone.
fun-and-games.craftTanglish: Romba nalla Fun and Games ore samayathula kalikkavum vekkum, arikkavum seiyum. Unga rendaam angam verum fun-aa mattum irundhaa, midpoint thaniyaave ellaa velaiyaiyum senjaaganum.

midpoint.inFilm: A false defeat, and the cruellest kind: he learns that the encounter from the opening image killed the wrong person, and that he is implicated in it. The certainty established in the set-up collapses in one line.
midpoint.inFilmTanglish: Poyyaana thotru - adhula romba kodiya vagai: thodakka katchila nadandha encounter thappaana aala kondadhu-nu, adhula thaanum sikkirukken-nu therinjukraan. Set-up-la nirupikkapatta andha urudhi ore vaarthaila sarindhu vizhudhu.
midpoint.craft: Aim the midpoint at the opening image. Undoing the first thing you showed is the most economical stakes raise there is.
midpoint.craftTanglish: Midpoint-a thodakka katchi mela kurivachu adinga. Mudhalla neenga kaattinadhaiye thalakeezhaakkuradhu thaan mikka milivaana pandhaya uyarvu.

bad-guys-close-in.inFilm: The threat relocates to his own side - a partner on the take, a superior running the unit for someone else. The institution he defended in act one becomes the antagonist, which means he cannot call anyone for help.
bad-guys-close-in.inFilmTanglish: Achchuruthhal avanoda pakkathukke maarudhu - laanjam vaangura oru partner, vera oruthanukkaaga unit-a nadathura oru mela adhigaari. Mudhal angathula avan kaaththa andha amaippe ippo edhiri - adhaala avan yaara koopta-um mudiyaadhu.
bad-guys-close-in.craft: The strongest Bad Guys Close In is when the hero loses the phone call. Take away who he can ring, not what he can do.
bad-guys-close-in.craftTanglish: Romba valimaiyaana Bad Guys Close In - hero-kku phone pannura vaaippu poradhu. Avanaala enna seiya mudiyum-nu illa, yaara koopda mudiyum-nu adha edunga.

all-is-lost.inFilm: The partner is executed by their own people. What dies is not only a man but the last version of the institution the hero could still have believed in.
all-is-lost.inFilmTanglish: Partner-a avanga aatkaleye kondraanga. Sagiradhu oru manushan mattumilla - hero innum nambikirundha andha amaippoda kadaisi vadivamum thaan.
all-is-lost.craft: Kill the belief, not just the friend. A death only lands as All Is Lost if it takes an idea with it.
all-is-lost.craftTanglish: Nanban mattumilla, nambikkaiyaiyum kolunga. Oru saavu, oru karuthaiyum serthu eduthu ponaa mattum thaan All Is Lost-aa vizhum.

dark-night.inFilm: A man with no side. Not the law, which has been shown to be for sale, and not the gang, which he has spent a career shooting at. The beat is defined by the absence of anywhere to stand.
dark-night.inFilmTanglish: Entha pakkamume illaadha oru manushan. Sattam illa - adhu vilaikku vikkapaduradhu nirupikkapattaachu; gang-um illa - andha velaiye avan career muzhusum suttu thallaradhu thaan. Nikka edame illaadhadhu thaan indha kattatha varaiyarukkudhu.
dark-night.craft: Dark Night of the Soul is not sadness, it is homelessness. Remove the position, not the mood.
dark-night.craftTanglish: Dark Night of the Soul-nu solradhu sogam illa, edamindri poradhu. Manonilaiya illa, nilaipaatta edunga.

break-into-three.inFilm: He adopts the antagonist's method. Having spent the film being asked questions and answering them badly, he stops answering and starts choosing - which is exactly what the folktale said a man in his position would eventually have to do.
break-into-three.inFilmTanglish: Edhiri-oda muraiyaiye avan ethukraan. Padam muzhusum kelvigal kekkapattu, molla badhil sollittu irundhavan - ippo badhil solradha nirutthittu thernthedukka aarambikraan. Avan nilaimaila irukkura oruthan kadaisila idha thaan seiya vendi varum-nu andha nadodi kadhai sonnadhum idhu thaan.
break-into-three.craft: Let the hero finish the film using the antagonist's tool. It is the only way to prove the antagonist was an argument and not an obstacle.
break-into-three.craftTanglish: Edhiri-oda karuviya vachu hero padatha mudikkattum. Edhiri oru thadai illa oru vaadham-nu nirupikka idhu thaan ore vazhi.

finale.inFilm: The two of them clear the corrupt unit together, and the hero personally finishes the man who ran it. The hard version of the thing he dodged is not violence - he was always willing to do violence. It is choosing who deserves it, with no institution left to decide for him.
finale.inFilmTanglish: Rendu perum serndhu andha oozhal unit-a sutthapaduthuraanga; adha nadathhinavana hero thaane mudikraan. Avan thavirthu odina velai-oda kadinamaana vadivam vanmurai illa - vanmurai seiya avan eppovume thayaraa thaan irundhaan. Yaaru adhukku thagudhiyaanavan-nu thaane thernthedukkuradhu thaan - adha avanukkaaga mudivu pannura amaippu ippo illa.
finale.craft: If your hero was always capable of the act, make the finale about who chooses it. Capability is not a climax; responsibility is.
finale.craftTanglish: Unga hero-kku andha seyala seiyura thiramai eppovume irundhuchunna, climax-a 'adha yaaru thernthedukraanga'-nu aakkunga. Thiramai oru climax illa; poruppu thaan.

final-image.inFilm: A standoff, and the question left open. The film returns the riddle to the audience instead of resolving it - which is not an evasion but the folktale's own ending, honoured. The frame promised questions with more than one answer, and the last frame refuses to pick one.
final-image.inFilmTanglish: Oru standoff, kelvi thirandhe vidapadudhu. Pudhira theerkkaama audience kitta padam thirumba kudukkudhu - idhu thappikkuradhu illa, andha nadodi kadhaioda sontha mudivukku madhippu kudukkuradhu. Oru badhilukku mela irukkum-nu frame vaakkuruthi kudutthudhu; kadaisi frame ondra thernthedukka maruthudhu.
final-image.craft: You may end on the question if you opened on it. An unanswered ending is a cheat only when the film never said it was asking.
final-image.craftTanglish: Kelvila aarambichirundhaa, kelvilaye mudikkalaam. Padam kekkudhu-nu sollaama irundhaa mattum thaan badhil illaadha mudivu oru emaaththal.
